title: Gaussian-Perturbed 100nm Uniform Initialization with Step-Size Control
scientific_hypothesis: Reinitializing candidates with tightly bounded Gaussian perturbations (σ=10 nm) centered on the Round 1 uniform 100.0 nm vector, combined with a hard step-size limiter of 15 nm per iteration and inter-layer thickness variance penalty >40 nm, will preserve foundational interference conditions while enabling gradual passband profile refinement without destructive overshoot.
design_principle: Maintain the optical impedance foundation from the best-performing uniform initialization while constraining optimization trajectory to prevent convergence into local minima that degrade passband transmission.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: inter-layer thickness variance penalty encourages smooth transitions for deposition repeatability
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack optimization principles for multi-band filters
Gradient-based optimization with bounded step-size for thin-film design
expected_advantages: Preserves interference foundation from Round 1 best score (0.9275)
Step-size control prevents destructive thickness changes
Variance penalty encourages manufacturable smooth transitions
known_risks: May converge to similar local minimum as prior iterations if perturbation range is too narrow
Variance penalty could constrain exploration of high-performing non-smooth solutions
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 dielectric filter on fused silica substrate at 0 deg incidence, unpolarized light. Layer sequence: Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2 (18 pairs, 36 layers total). Initialize all 36 layer thicknesses with Gaussian perturbations (standard deviation 10 nm) centered on 100.0 nm uniform baseline. Apply hard step-size limiter of 15 nm maximum change per iteration. Apply penalty weight for inter-layer thickness variance exceeding 40 nm. Thickness bounds: 20-350 nm per layer. Target bands: maximize transmittance 420-700 nm, minimize transmittance 354-356 nm, minimize transmittance 355-365 nm, minimize transmittance 1030-1080 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with the specified initialization and constraints. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Directly implements insight appendage feedback: Gaussian perturbation (σ=10 nm) around Round 1 uniform 100.0 nm baseline, 15 nm step-size limiter, and >40 nm variance penalty. This differs from prior route_02 iterations which used quarter-wave initialization (iter 11), bimodal initialization (iter 19), or unconstrained gradient optimization (iter 15).
